name: retold-operation-queue
description: Intent/control layer over an execution queue: durable operation groups that lazily expand into leaf tasks, lane-based preemptive priority, cache-key dedup, and metered dispatch of a bounded window into a worker queue (for example Ultravisor). The source of truth for very large, browse-driven operation backlogs.

scripts.schema:compile: npx stricture compile data_model/Operation-Queue.ddl -o data_model/compiled/ -p OperationQueue
